newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Former U.S. legislator wants to stop Israeli abortions. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Former U.S. legislator wants to stop Israeli abortions. [CORRECTED 14:05 GMT]

text.p: A former U.S. legislator opposed to abortions recently visited Israel in a bid to curb abortions in the Jewish state, an Israeli newspaper said on Friday.
Haaretz newspaper said Bob Dornan, a former congressman from California met Israeli anti-abortion activists and religious politicians to discuss strategies against abortions in Israel.
(Corrects headline and text to make clear Dornan no longer in Congress).

The newspaper quoted Dornan as saying he would fight the Israeli army's paying for abortions for soldiers "with U.S. aid funds". Israel receives $1.8 billion in military aid from the United States annually.
Israeli officials were not immediately available to comment on the newspaper report.
The newspaper said Dornan promised to invite Israeli officials to the U.S. to study the abortion issue.
It said Dornan cancelled a planned news conference in Israel because of national mourning over 73 soldiers killed last week in an air crash.
